cohort: 101 pregnant and postpartum women with SARS-CoV-2 infection requiring intensive care treatment for COVID-19 from the CRONOS registry.
finding: Progression of COVID-19 requiring ICU treatment is rare in pregnant and postpartum women, but preterm birth rate is high, and COVID-19 requiring respiratory support increases the risk of poor maternal and neonatal outcome.
gest_age: Median gestational age at COVID-19 diagnosis: 33 weeks (IQR, 28-35)
who: Pregnant and postpartum women and their infants
